dimensions.name: Autonomous operations
dimensions.blocker: Two consecutive Phase 1G/1H internal-test order runs lost their wake notification to a same-iteration trigger-state overwrite and required operator re-parking; live premium-production runs also continue to need incident-driven repair.

dimensions.name: Operational reliability
dimensions.blocker: Controlled proof runs are still surfacing new production-only failure classes at high frequency across validator semantics, truth claims, asset availability, critique handling and order wake delivery.

dimensions.name: Customer fulfillment
dimensions.blocker: The fulfillment, activation, reporting and billing chain is implemented, but there is still no clean paid external end-to-end completion and internal premium website orders still require operator rescue.

dimensions.name: AI / agent capability
dimensions.blocker: The stack now produces judged studies and bounded page revisions, but art-director/critic outputs still hit real schema and semantic edge cases that require deterministic repair.

dimensions.name: Website Builder maturity
dimensions.blocker: The engine has advanced beyond the prior write-action stall into real design-system, build, critique and revision loops, but no controlled proof has yet established repeatable premium-quality unattended completion.

dimensions.name: Commercial readiness
dimensions.blocker: Offer, activation, checkout, entitlement, reporting and billing are credible, but customer proof and repeatable autonomous fulfillment are still absent.

dimensions.name: Acquisition readiness
dimensions.blocker: No repeatable acquisition or lead-to-paid conversion loop is proven, and the public company still reports no customers.

dimensions.name: Business / economic proof
dimensions.blocker: No verified paying Stromation customers or recurring revenue exist yet; the venture portfolio remains parked and its last property retired.

changed: The single biggest change is that premium Website Builder proof progressed into real judged and revision loops, but autonomy evidence worsened: a sequence of validator, truth, asset and critic failures was followed by two consecutive Phase 1G/1H test-order wakes being overwritten in the same loop iteration, leaving jobs idle until manual rescue. Main now contains targeted repairs through PR #135, which raises technical confidence but does not yet prove unattended convergence.
method: Expanded independent forecast grounded in Sep. 12-13 main-branch implementation through PR #135, Phase 1E/1F/1G/1H controlled-proof run evidence, the generated CURRENT_STATE proof of customer fulfillment/activation/billing, current public no-customer/parked-venture truth, and absence of verified recurring revenue. Forward-looking values are estimates, not guarantees.
